open.issue: 1.8 uF 0603: no maker part found in stock (no Samsung/Murata/TDK/Taiyo 1.8 uF 0603 at LCSC; only CCTC TCC0603X5R185K160CT, 0 pcs). A search snippet gives 5.2 s/uF on top of 64 ms; if confirmed, 1.8 uF = 9.4 s, 2.2 uF (CL10A225KO8NNNC, LCSC C23630, JLC basic) = 11.5 s, 1.5 uF = 7.9 s. Pick the value against the long-hold target, then check X5R tolerance and temperature drift.

A search snippet says C grade = 0..70 C and I grade = -40..85 C. An outdoor camera needs the I grade (LTC2955ITS8-1#TRMPBF). Confirm from the ADI data sheet.

PESD5V0S1BA on USB_CC1/CC2 breaks down at 5.5-9.5 V (Nexperia). If a damaged cable or debris shorts CC to VBUS at 9 V PD, the diode takes current from the 9 V source and can fail short. The STUSB4500 CC short-to-VBUS rating could not be checked (ST data sheet did not load). Use a CC ESD part with VRWM >= 20 V and low capacitance, or confirm with ST that the STUSB4500 alone meets the ESD target.

BQ27441-G1 data sheet (TI, current revision) says SRP/SRN expect a 10 mOhm HIGH-SIDE sense resistor: SRP to the PACK+ side, SRN to VSYS. circuit.py wires it low-side (SRP = GND, SRN = PACK_MINUS). The coulomb-counter input range is VSR +-25 mV, so 10 mOhm saturates above 2.5 A; the 5 A planning current gives 50 mV. Either follow TI (high-side) and drop to 5 mOhm with CC-gain recalibration, or confirm low-side support with TI and accept a 2.5 A counting limit.
Mated height needs the male header fitted to the XIAO: socket 8.5 mm + that header body (2.5 mm standard -> 11.0 mm). Define the XIAO header part and check enclosure and lens height against 11.0 mm.
Footprint change 1812 -> 1206 required for the selected Bourns SF-1206F700-2. Also confirm the protected pack short-circuit current and trip time against the 50 A interrupting rating.
AO4407A RDS(on) is not specified at VGS = -5 V, the drive level on BOOST_5V and in the 5 V PD fallback. Measure the drop at the real load (boost path ~2.6 A) or pick a P-FET specified at -4.5 V.
